raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that both Philip K. Dick and Ray Nelson “wrote both” works, conflating Ray Nelson’s co-authorship of The Ganymede Takeover with authorship of The Man in the High Castle. Ray Nelson did not write The Man in the High Castle; the correct common author is Philip K. Dick.
